## SparrowOS

Platforms & internal tools · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · In use
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrowos/

The operations platform Sage Sparrows runs on. It replaced scattered Google Sheets and WhatsApp threads with one place for tasks, chat, KPIs and analytics across every brand the agency manages.

What was built:
- Tasks with a reviewer-driven stage flow, real-time chat (threads, mentions, reactions, file sharing), Google Calendar sync and global search
- Built-in mail and drive on the company's own Stalwart server, private notes with share links, and a daily standup board
- KPI calculator with weighted department scoring, MD scores and profit sharing
- Daily pipelines from Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Shopify, Microsoft Clarity and Google Trends feeding per-brand revenue, traffic, conversion and ad dashboards
- Ad evaluation engine that sorts every ad into test, kill, optimise, breakeven or scale
- Six-tier roles, TOTP-gated impersonation, web push with retries and batching, and a WebSocket build id that reloads clients after a deploy
- Plain-English and voice commands across 47 tools, with an undo log and single-use plan tokens

Results:
- In daily use at os.sagesparrows.in: on 2 Sep 2026 it held 9 brands, 56 campaigns, about 110 assets and 120 open tasks
- Replaced Google Sheets and WhatsApp as the way the team runs work, with productivity and progress tracking up by about 70%

Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Node.js, Fastify, MySQL, WebSocket, Google APIs, Meta Graph API, Web Push

## SparrowOS for Mac

Platforms & internal tools · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · In use
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrowos-mac/

A native SwiftUI client for SparrowOS, built from scratch rather than wrapped around the web app, so the team gets a real dock app and notifications that actually arrive.

What was built:
- Every web page rebuilt natively: dashboard, tasks, calendar, chat, mail, drive, notes, KPIs, settings and all 16 analytics dashboards
- Local-first: a whole-database SQLCipher cache keeps the app usable when the server has a bad day
- Hold Option+Space in any app and speak or type a command; dictation and the Atlas 1.0 model both run on the Mac
- Morning standup drafts of each person's day, confirmed and sent to the founder as one summary at noon
- Native sign-in with revocable per-device tokens in the Keychain
- Own release pipeline: versioned builds, DMG, appcast and an in-app updater with release notes; about 27,600 lines of Swift

Results:
- 16 builds shipped to the team through its own updater, the latest being v0.5.0 on 22 Sep 2026

Stack: Swift, SwiftUI, SQLCipher, CryptoKit, MLX, Speech, XcodeGen

## SparrowOS for Windows

Platforms & internal tools · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · Planned
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrowos-windows/

The Windows sibling of the Mac app: a native WinUI 3 client with the same layouts and navigation, in Fluent Design instead of Liquid Glass.

What was built:
- Full build plan: SwiftUI to WinUI screen map, tooling versions and a phased build order
- x64 and ARM64 from one C# codebase, shipped as a single MSIX bundle
- SparrowCrypto re-implemented in C# against the same versioned spec, so encrypted local data stays portable between clients

Stack: C#, .NET 10, WinUI 3, Windows App SDK, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm

## SparrowCrypto

Platforms & internal tools · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · Built
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrowcrypto/

One owned encryption format for company data across every SparrowOS client and the backend: a versioned envelope over standard AES-256-GCM.

What was built:
- Owns the format, key hierarchy and rotation, and never invents the cipher itself
- A byte-for-byte spec that web, macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and the server can all implement
- Zero dependencies on every platform: Node crypto, CryptoKit, javax.crypto, .NET and WebCrypto

Stack: AES-256-GCM, Node.js, Swift, CryptoKit

## Sparrow Git

Platforms & internal tools · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · In use
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrow-git/

A private VS Code extension that gives the team a visual Git workflow in the sidebar, so nobody has to fight the terminal.

What was built:
- Enforces team conventions: branch naming, commit prefixes and protected main
- Smart Split, AI suggestions for commits, branches and PRs, and pull request review from the editor
- Background branch health monitoring, with a lock that keeps pollers from colliding with the user's own git commands
- Refuses commits in detached HEAD and on protected branches

Stack: TypeScript, VS Code API, simple-git, GitHub CLI, esbuild

## Sparrow Mail & Drive

Platforms & internal tools · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · In use
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrow-mail/

The company's own workspace instead of a Google Workspace subscription: email, calendars and file storage self-hosted on Stalwart, with SparrowOS as the interface.

What was built:
- Stalwart on the company VPS serving IMAP, SMTP, JMAP, CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV, so Apple Mail and phones sync natively
- Web mail inside SparrowOS over JMAP, with attachments, snooze and shared team inboxes
- Mailbox admin in SparrowOS: create and remove accounts with storage quotas, and manage shared inboxes
- Sparrow Drive: each person's files on Stalwart over WebDAV, with share links minted by SparrowOS
- DKIM-signed mail with SPF and DMARC, after finding the rotating-key trap that lets Gmail silently drop mail
- Began as a small self-built Node SMTP service, replaced by Stalwart once a full workspace was in scope

Results:
- Runs the company's mail domain, and sends the storefront checkout alerts

Stack: Stalwart, JMAP, IMAP, WebDAV, CalDAV, Node.js, Fastify, nginx

## Sparrow Commerce

Client apps & platforms · Verte · 2026 · In progress
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrow-commerce/

A commerce backend and merchant admin built to take Verte off Shopify: one Next.js app with the admin dashboard and a token-authenticated storefront API.

What was built:
- Admin for products, collections, inventory, price lists, subscriptions, orders, carts, customers, discounts, reviews, GST, analytics, reports, content, email and team
- Storefront API for catalog, search, cart, checkout, customer accounts, discounts and event ingestion
- Stripe Checkout with webhooks; a storefront moves onto it by changing one file
- Docker review stack (admin, demo storefront, seeded Postgres and Caddy with basic auth) so stakeholders can click through it safely
- About 25,000 lines of TypeScript

Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Stripe, Docker

## Verte global storefront

Client apps & platforms · Verte · 2026 · Live
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/verte-web/
Live: https://vertewatches.com

vertewatches.com: a headless Next.js port of Verte's Shopify theme that sells worldwide in USD through its own Stripe checkout.

What was built:
- The theme's JSON templates are imported and rendered in React, so pages keep the same sections and settings as the Shopify store
- Stripe checkout with orders created back in Shopify, and USD prices read from variant metafields
- Geo split that sends Indian visitors to verte.co.in while keeping both sites indexable
- SEO pass: sitemap, robots, Product and Organization JSON-LD with ratings and shipping policy, hreflang and H1s
- Fixed the layout shift that was failing Core Web Vitals (CLS 0.52 on phones) by measuring every element with and without media
- Review stars and a region-aware payment and pay-later line on every watch page
- Host allowlist, Cloudflare WAF and authenticated origin pulls against a live reverse-proxy clone of the site
- Fixed a thank-you page that reported unpaid checkouts to Meta as purchases
- About 43,000 lines of TypeScript

Results:
- 96 orders through its own Stripe checkout from launch on 19 May to 23 Oct 2026 (Shopify count, team orders included)

Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Shopify Storefront API, Zustand, Cloudflare, PM2

## Verte profit analytics

Client apps & platforms · Verte · 2026 · Live
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/verte-profit/

A single-purpose profit app for Verte, because revenue minus product cost leaves out ad spend, shipping, gateway fees, returns and packaging.

What was built:
- Every cost carries its provenance (measured, rate card, assumed or unknown) and no cost is ever silently zero
- Every figure states its coverage, so the app was useful on day one and gets more accurate as estimates are replaced
- Checkout health alert: a Playwright test checkout every 15 minutes, an email alert and a one-click button to pause the India ads, added after the payment step silently failed for hours while the vendor's status page showed 100% uptime
- Built and verified against live data in about four days

Results:
- Live at pa.vertewatches.com; the checkout alert has watched the India checkout since 8 Oct 2026

Stack: Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, Nodemailer, Playwright

## Atlas 1.0

AI & ML · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · In use
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/atlas/

The first model in SparrowOS Intelligence: a small model fine-tuned to turn plain-English requests into SparrowOS actions, running on each person's own Mac.

What was built:
- Benchmarked 34 open models on tool calling first; the best managed only about half, so fine-tuning was required
- LoRA fine-tune of Qwen3.5-2B (4-bit) on Apple MLX, with checkpoint averaging
- 88.6% on a frozen 297-case test set, with model selection done on a separate validation set so the number is honest
- Caught and retracted an earlier 90.2% that had been selected on the test set itself
- Later runs on Colab L4 GPUs, guarded by a corpus validator and a 36-test harness where every test is a bug that once happened

Results:
- 88.6% on 297 held-out cases, against roughly half for the best model before fine-tuning
- Standup commands: 33 of 38 right, up from 12 with the model that had been shipping

Stack: Python, MLX, LoRA, Qwen3.5, Swift, Google Colab

## AI product shoot pipeline

AI & ML · Sage Sparrows clients · 2026 · In use
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/ai-product-shoot/

A Python suite that takes a product from raw photos to a live Shopify listing: AI model shots, AI descriptions, upscaling, resizing and upload.

What was built:
- Gemini (Nano Banana Pro) generates six lifestyle variations per product from one model photo and one product photo
- Gemini writes SEO titles and HTML descriptions from the raw images
- 4x upscaling locally with SwinIR and GFPGAN face restoration, or through the Topaz API
- Resizes to 3:4, compresses to a target size and uploads through the Shopify Admin API, all from one interactive menu

Stack: Python, Gemini API, Pillow, PyTorch, OpenCV, Shopify Admin API

## Local LLM evaluation

AI & ML · Personal · 2026 · Delivered
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/local-llm-eval/

A harness that measures what moving coding and analytics work to a local model on a 24 GB MacBook would really cost in quality.

What was built:
- Speed bench, a blind-graded set of 12 weighted tasks built from real traps, and a multi-file editing task scored by whether the patch applies and the tests pass
- Finding: roughly 40 to 49% of frontier multi-file ability is the realistic ceiling; vendor benchmark claims ran about 2.5x high
- Measured rules for this hardware: mixture-of-experts models only, MLX over GGUF, and the config traps that quietly degrade output

Stack: Python, MLX, Ollama

## Novel knowledge graph

AI & ML · Personal · 2026 · Delivered
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/booktheory/

An LLM extraction pipeline that read all 1,431 chapters of a web novel and built a queryable record of who knows what, and when.

What was built:
- 45,549 facts, 7,304 relationships and 1,912 aliases resolved to 4,386 distinct entities
- Runs on a local Qwen3-14B through LM Studio, or a cloud model by config
- Alias resolution folds a character's many names into one entity

Stack: Python, LM Studio, Qwen3, OpenAI-compatible API

## Hinglish transcription

AI & ML · Sage Sparrows client · 2026 · Delivered
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/hinglish-transcription/

Fully local transcription of Hindi and English interviews for testimonial reels: 24 minutes of audio in about 2.3 minutes on a MacBook.

What was built:
- A Whisper large-v3 fine-tune prompted for mixed output: Hindi in Devanagari, English in Latin script
- Pause-aware chunking, with weak chunks re-decoded by beam search and compared
- Word timings for cutting reels, and every cut read back to catch dropped or invented words

Stack: Python, Transformers, Whisper, PyTorch

## SparrowOS MCP server

Claude skills & MCP · Sage Sparrows · 2026 · In use
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/sparrowos-mcp/

Lets Claude Code ask the live SparrowOS server analytics questions directly, instead of exporting a 3.5 GB database dump every time.

What was built:
- Read-only, and scoped by the same roles and brand access as the apps
- Token kept in the macOS Keychain, expires after 90 days and can be revoked from Settings
- Tools for metrics, fact rows, brand sources and full reports

## Project Karbon 3D viewer

3D & CAD · Verte · 2026 · Built
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/karbon-3d/

A real-time 3D Karbon for Verte's product pages, with a working movement behind the exhibition caseback and hands that tell the viewer's own time.

What was built:
- The second hand steps 8 times a second, matching the Miyota 9015's 28,800 vph, with every hand checked against seven clock times
- Balance wheel oscillates at exactly 4 Hz; the rotor has inertia and is spun by dragging, as on a wrist
- Gears turn at speeds inverse to their radius, neighbours counter-rotating, and the hairspring coils instead of spinning
- Blender prep: a fused 113,000-vertex fittings mesh split into 93 parts, gears named by size and the missing balance wheel built
- Materials made physically valid (the crystal had been an opaque metal), and the washed-out look traced to an HDR used as the backdrop
- Section-scoped three.js viewer, about 1,860 lines, with a fisheye sheet of review cards around the watch

Stack: three.js, Blender, glTF, Draco, gltf-transform, Shopify

## Cosmic studio roto

Video, photo & VFX · Alexandre Christie · 2026 · Delivered
URL: https://smithmankar.co.in/projects/cosmic-roto/

Isolated a model from a 4K, 60 fps studio take (1,216 frames) onto clean green, removing the director, light stands, cables and floor.

What was built:
- BiRefNet HR matting in fp16 on Apple silicon, about 5x faster than full precision
- A screen-colour key caps the matte; the director is removed with tracked masks
- Flicker measured as pixel oscillations and cut by about 5x from the first version
- Six versions against client feedback, with a hole scanner run on every render

Stack: Python, PyTorch, BiRefNet, OpenCV, ffmpeg
